project.name: pic-sure-shadow-reconciler
project.description: Standalone offline reconciler for the gateway/WildFly auth-parity shadow logs. Parses the SHADOW_GW and SHADOW_WF JSONL streams, joins records by correlation id, and classifies each pair (MATCH / EXPECTED_DIFF / INTENTIONAL_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE / DIVERGENCE / UNPAIRED / SKIP) against an independently-authored canonical reference mapping. Deliberately has NO dependency on services/pic-sure-gateway: it defines its own ShadowRecord and its own reference table so a gateway resolver bug surfaces as a divergence instead of matching itself.
